title: Mixed Event — Hear Me! Hopeful Show♪ — Episode5 Essentials of Being a Professional

meta.Episode: Episode5 — Essentials of Being a Professional
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! continue their livestreams, but Minori is plagued with unease as she fails to find acceptance from the group's fans. One day, an opportunity arises for a collaboration with a famous former idol turned streamer...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, Minori! If I didn't make you do that, we could've ended it so much smoother...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's my fault for not getting it right! I should be the one apologizing. Not you, Nanamin...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: To be fair, these things always happen during streams, so I wouldn't worry too much about it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we'll talk more about that later...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for inviting us here today, Hayakawa. We'll be looking forward to the show.

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
Yup, see you then!
I can't wait to perform with you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm so sorry about what happened...! This was a huge opportunity to get our name out there and I just...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's okay, Minori. We know that you're doing your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we also can't let doubt creep into our viewers' minds.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As long as you're an idol, situations like that where you have to think on your feet will come up time and time again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're risk-reward opportunities where you'll have to decide what will or won't work in that moment.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's also important to say no to things you think you won't be able to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you sure about this, Minori?
You don't have to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're still new to this, so you'll just have to keep learning, keep experiencing new things and keep on trying.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And everyone makes mistakes. I made plenty when I was just starting out too so...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're just gonna have to use this to bounce back when we do our show next time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And it'll be our first show as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll do a ton of practice to make sure everyone enjoys it too! I have to keep trying, more and more...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (All our fans were looking forward to seeing today's stream too...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Next time, you'll get to see MORE MORE JUMP! and Nanamin perform together in a show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I can't wait either! It'll be our first actual show as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and we have Nanamin to thank for giving us such a great opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She'll just blow it again...>
<For Haruka's sake, don't screw up!>
<Stay off to the side.>

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
She seems so plain.
Like a normal person, you know?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Yeah, the other three alone seems like plenty. Why do they need her around?

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: She messed up pretty bad today too. Maybe she's Haruka's friend or something?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm trying to become an idol that can bring hope to everyone, like Haruka...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm trying my best, but I'm no match for everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Instead of helping, I'm holding them back...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Can I really be an idol...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone! Thanks for coming to see us today♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We hope you'll come and see our next show too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow! We're done with our encore, but they're still going.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then let's give them one last song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I was just thinking about something... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We were just about to sing another song as part of an encore. Would you like to sing with us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm okay...!
I'll be cheering you on!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You were all amazing!
It was such a good show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it felt like you weren't smiling like you meant it, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The others are so great at being idols and I wanted to be just like them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew that it wouldn't be easy either...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But it feels like nothing I do is working. It feels like I'm never gonna be able to become a real idol like them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What am I supposed to do...?
All I'm doing is holding them back...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku and Luka are so amazing at singing and dancing, and they never make any mistakes!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So I always feel like I'm the one that's holding them back sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I keep hoping that I'll be like them someday...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin, I never knew you felt that way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What if you strive to be your own self instead of like someone else...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think it's great that Minori and Rin work so hard at what they do! I'm sure the fans feel the same way!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So I believe you two will be fine just the way you are.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Miku, thank you.
But that might not be...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Exactly! We try and try and try but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also believe that you two are able to do things that no one else can.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh! I wave my hands more than Miku or Luka! Everyone always seems really happy when I do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something no one else can do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What can I do that no one else can...?
